topic: 6 Red Flags to Watch for in a Finance Offer
objective: Give a checklist of warning signs to watch for when evaluating a finance offer, in a compliant, non-alarmist way.

slides.subheadline: Slow down if you notice any of these.

slides.headline: Why it matters
bullet_points: Reluctance to explain fees or terms clearly
Pressure to sign quickly without time to review
Vague or missing information about the total cost
No clear licensing or credentials on request

caption:
The large majority of business finance offers in Australia are entirely legitimate, but it's still worth knowing a few warning signs, pressure to sign quickly, vague fee explanations, or a reluctance to answer direct questions.

If something feels off, slowing down and asking more questions costs nothing.
